title: Eton Mess with Honey Glazed Daikon
description: A twist on the classic Eton Mess dessert, featuring honey glazed daikon and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: Peel and slice the daikon into thin rounds.
In a small saucepan, combine honey and 1 tablespoon water. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Brush the honey glaze over the daikon slices.
Place the daikon slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the daikon is tender and caramelized.
In a large bowl, combine the meringue, fresh berries, and heavy cream.
Spoon the meringue mixture over the daikon slices.
Top with Eton Mess and serve immediately.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
